name: paylark
description: Paylark payments for Claude Code: the Paylark MCP server plus skills for adding checkout, subscriptions, license keys and signed webhooks to your app.

api_key.title: Paylark API key
api_key.description: Secret key from Dashboard → Developers → API keys. Use a test key (sk_test_...); live keys only get read-only tools.

api_base.title: Paylark API base URL
api_base.description: Where your Paylark server runs, without a trailing slash, e.g. https://app.example.com or http://localhost:8080.
